  namespace: default

import { KanbanData } from '../../wk-integration/interfaces/kanban-data.interface.dto';

/**
 * Convert a buffer line (from Order API) to KanbanData format for revalidation.
 * The KanbanData interface uses PascalCase property names by design (XML mapping).
 * @param bufferLine - The buffer line object from Order API
 * @returns KanbanData compatible with validateAndAssign
 */
export const bufferLineToKanbanData = (
  bufferLine: Record<string, unknown>,
): KanbanData => ({
  Action: (bufferLine.actionType as string) ?? undefined,
  Batch: (bufferLine.batch as string) ?? undefined,
  BatchTest: (bufferLine.batchTest as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType1: (bufferLine.calendarType1 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType2: (bufferLine.calendarType2 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType3: (bufferLine.calendarType3 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType4: (bufferLine.calendarType4 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType5: (bufferLine.calendarType5 as string) ?? undefined,
  CalendarType6: (bufferLine.calendarType6 as string) ?? undefined,
  Customer: (bufferLine.customer as string) ?? undefined,
  DeliveryNumber: (bufferLine.deliveryNumber as string) ?? undefined,
  DestinationLocation: (bufferLine.destinationLocation as string) ?? undefined,
  EndPickingDateTime: (bufferLine.endPickingDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  EndPreparationDateTime:
    (bufferLine.endPreparationDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  EndProductionDateTime:
    (bufferLine.endProductionDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  LaunchingDateTime: (bufferLine.launchDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  MaterialNumber: (bufferLine.materialNumber as string) ?? undefined,
  OrderID: (bufferLine.orderId as string) ?? undefined,
  ProductionLine: (bufferLine.productionLine as string) ?? undefined,
  ProductionLineUPstream:
    (bufferLine.productionLineUpstream as string) ?? undefined,
  Quantity: (bufferLine.quantity as number) ?? undefined,
  SourceLocation: (bufferLine.sourceLocation as string) ?? undefined,
  StartPickingDateTime:
    (bufferLine.startPickingDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  StartProductionDateTime:
    (bufferLine.startProductionDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  TPANumber: (bufferLine.tpaNumber as string) ?? undefined,
  TruckDepartureDateTime:
    (bufferLine.truckDepartureDatetime as string) ?? undefined,
  UpstreamMaterial: (bufferLine.upstreamMaterial as string) ?? undefined,
});

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 20.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts-alpine AS base

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts AS build

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm install -D \
    && npm run build

# runtime stage
FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/dist dist/

COPY package.json package-lock.json .npmrc ./

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm install --omit=dev

USER node

CMD ["npm", "run", "start:prod"]
# WK Integration Backend

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: wkint-be

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      auditLevel: 'critical'


  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-dynamic-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)

  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/wk-integration-backend

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
